A WEB COMPONENT FOR PAGE AUDIO

MAKE YOUR AUDIO MOVE A SCENE

For site owners, streamers, and event makers who need a restrained visual without sending audio away.

Try it with sample data

THREE SCENES / ONE SMALL COMPONENT / YOUR AUDIO

THE WORKING COMPONENT

SHAPE THE SCENE HERE

Pick a look. Play the bundled sample, choose a file, or allow the microphone. The browser handles the selected audio source.

LIVE SCENE / RIBBONS
CHOOSE A SCENE

Play sample audio

MOTION
System setting
Full motion

Static poster is ready. Choose audio to make it move.

COPY THIS EMBED
<script type="module">
  import 'audio-reactive-scene';
  import 'audio-reactive-scene/style.css';
</script>
<audio-reactive-scene
  scene="ribbons"
  intensity="0.7"
  motion="auto">
</audio-reactive-scene>

Copy embed

HOW IT WORKS

CONNECT AUDIO IN THREE STEPS
ADD THE ELEMENT

Install the package and place the custom element where the scene belongs.

CONNECT YOUR SOURCE

Pass a Web Audio node after the visitor starts playback.

SET THE FALLBACK

Keep automatic motion reduction or choose the static poster.

CLEAR BOUNDARIES

YOUR AUDIO DOES NOT LEAVE

The component has no analytics or account system. It reads levels from the browser audio graph and sends no audio to an API.

It does not start audio on page load.
It does not ask for microphone access by itself.
It does not upload or save an audio file.
It does not load scripts or fonts from another site.

OPEN PACKAGE

INSTALL IT IN ONE LINE

The package ships ESM, CommonJS, and TypeScript declarations.

npm install audio-reactive-scene
